ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed @ 24.75) and overbought (daily RSI 77, 3-day 73 & weekly 74). A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 11 · daily cycle day 10).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 77, 3-day 73 & weekly 74). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸且超买（日线 RSI 77、3 日 73 与周线 74）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（近期形成 @ 24.75）且已超买（日线 RSI 77、3 日 73 与周线 74）。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量为正（投资者周期第 11 周 · 日线周期第 10 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A HIGH signal triggered 4 trading days ago (~2026-06-11), switching from BUY ZONE. Signal strength: faint (score -10/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近高点信号于 4 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-11），自买入区切换而来。 信号强度：微弱（评分 -10/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: light exit setting up (-15)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱离场构筑中（-15）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime — rate-neutral.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境——利率中性。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.09 ± 0.16 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLV) reads long-duration (+0.18). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.09 ± 0.16——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLV）为长久期（+0.18）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
